title: Pauli-X / Sign Twirling Conversion of Coherent Carry Error to Stochastic Dephasing
claims: An uncompensated coherent phase carry error U_delta = diag(1, exp(i * delta)) has linear worst-case state trace distance D_tr^{coherent}(delta) = |sin(delta / 2)| = O(|delta|).

Conjugating by {I, X} twirling (or averaging balanced +/- delta syndrome branches) cancels the imaginary skew and produces a pure phase-flip channel with quadratic trace distance D_tr^{twirled}(delta) = sin^2(delta / 2) = (D_tr^{coherent}(delta))^2.
favorable_controls: Sweep across delta in {0.02, 0.05, 0.10, 0.25, pi/2, pi} (>20.0x suppression at delta = 0.10 rad)
